name: signalk-wasm
description: WebAssembly in SignalK: WASM plugins run in Node WASI with only the sk_* host imports (isolated, not a security boundary) — when to use one vs a Node plugin or native process, the Rust/AssemblyScript ABI, capabilities, endpoints and a Datastar UI recipe, Rust traps on wasm32-wasip1, Rust and AssemblyScript starters, a version matrix of runtime limits — and wasm-pack libraries inside Node plugins.
